title: Where the work sits · ET-SoC-1
description: Does the ET-SoC-1's clock governor act on the mean of its die sensors or on the hottest one, and does the same work run longer before the thermal trip when it is placed on the edges of the die? Theories and predictions first, development on aifoundry3, a frozen and hashed pre-registration, a calibration and a validation on aifoundry1 card 1: the placements on the die, the time to 66 °C from the same start, and which theories survived.
